description: JAX-hosted REST service for searching HPO terms, retrieving term records, and traversing ancestor, parent, child, and descendant relationships. Disease, gene, and medical-action annotations are provided through the separate Ontology Annotation Network API.
resolution_notes: docs_url: replace with https://ontology.jax.org/api/hp/docs/; official Swagger lists HPO search, term, and hierarchy routes. cors: yes; https://github.com/TheJacksonLaboratory/ontology-service/blob/main/src/main/resources/application.yml sets server CORS enabled. example: use limit, not max; https://github.com/TheJacksonLaboratory/ontology-service/blob/main/src/main/java/org/jacksonlaboratory/controller/SearchController.java defines q/page/limit and -1 means all. description: remove annotation claims; https://ontology.jax.org/Annotations/ identifies annotations as a separate API.
